8,397 likes, 47 comments - foodpharmer on October 25, 2026: "How toothpaste brands fool you! 

Full podcast out now on my YouTube channel “Food Pharmer”.

From teeth whitening, charcoal toothpaste, oil pulling and the marketing of children’s toothpaste, how much of what we see is science, and how much is marketing?

In this episode, I sit down with @iampuneetnandaindia , an oral care expert to discuss:
• Toothpaste Marketing Gimmicks
• How to Read a Toothpaste Label
• The Truth About “9 Out of 10 Dentists Recommend”
• How to choose the right toothbrushes 
• How to buy the right toothpaste
• How to fix bad breath
• Children’s Toothpaste Marketing

This conversation aims to help you understand oral care products better, ask the right questions, and make informed decisions for yourself and your family.

#collab".
